reason: Phase 1 (Foundation) established four durable rules: the runtime adapter spawn/cap conventions (runBounded + mapSpawnError + the two named caps), the error-kind contract (a kind names the real cause; docs/troubleshooting.md is the single enumeration; refusals go through the shared audit builder; a refusal is typed), the repository's Kata task conventions (requirements-file seeding, owned-path declaration and seal-time extension, commit-before-acknowledge, phase-to-role mapping, gate mechanics), plus the build-constraint notes from the implementation run.
